# 611: Hva er billig og dyrt i markedet? Med Gaute Eie

**Feed**: pengepodden-no  
**Published**: 2026-09-17  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Gaute Eie, investment director at Eika, argues that geopolitics drives the market. He sees the US–China rivalry as a long cold war, which supports defence stocks. He expects oil to fall sharply once the Hormuz situation is resolved, and he does not see an AI bubble yet. He prefers AI infrastructure suppliers over the companies spending on AI. In Norway he is underweight oil and very bearish on salmon farmers, and overweight stocks where Eika's estimates are above consensus: Kongsberg Gruppen, Kitron, Nordic Semiconductor, AutoStore and especially Vend.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 KOG — Kongsberg Gruppen | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

10% of Eika's funds. Eika's revenue estimate of 100bn+ is above consensus of about 80bn; it expects margin expansion and a 10-15 year defence build-up.

#### Reasoning

The guest expects the US–China cold war to drive a multi-year defence build-up. Analysts have repeatedly raised estimates, and Eika's revenue forecast is well above consensus. With a 54% gross margin, rising revenue should mean margin expansion, while consensus sees EBITDA margins flat.

#### Sell Triggers

- if defence spending cycle fades
- if revenue fails to reach ~80-100bn
- if margins stay flat

> *"så den har vi i 10% av fondet og tror fortsatt at estimatene der, jeg ser konsensus 28,5-80 milliarder, vi har 100 pluss"*

---

### 🟢 KIT — Kitron | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Eika is a top-5 holder. Consensus of 17% growth for 2027 is too low when 50% of revenue is defence (drones); Eika expects a big 2027 surprise.

#### Reasoning

Kitron's revenue has grown 54% and about 70% of revenue will come from defence and data centres. Consensus growth of 17% contradicts the defence growth rates. Eika's revenue estimate for next year matches consensus for 2028, and the beat should flow straight to the bottom line.

#### Sell Triggers

- if 2027 revenue lands near 1bn EUR
- if defence/drone demand slows

> *"Så kitene kommer til å være en super, tror vi, surprise i 2027."*

---

### 🟢 NOD — Nordic Semiconductor | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

The industrial segment grew 45% (50% excluding Dexcom). Eika sees next year's consensus revenue (17% growth) as too low and IoT/AI edge as only just starting.

#### Reasoning

International analysts treat the company as a consumer stock. The guest argues that industrial (40% of revenue) and broad market are growing 40%+. With a 52-53% gross margin, higher revenue should lift earnings well above consensus.

#### Sell Triggers

- if 2027 revenue comes in around 950m
- if industrial growth decelerates

> *"vi tror jo at revenuen i Nordic neste år er konsensuskjorte"*

---

### 🟢 VEND — Vend | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Possibly the best risk-reward. Eika expects EBITDA growth of 25-30%, sees monopoly-like earnings with no debt, and treats it as a private-equity takeover candidate.

#### Reasoning

The stock is priced like international classifieds peers despite Finn's monopoly. Eika expects earnings of 3.5bn in 2027 and 4.23bn in 2028. A buyer using ~6x leverage on EBITDA of more than 4bn, plus the Adevinta stake, would need almost no equity. Private equity is recovering and needs safe assets.

#### Sell Triggers

- if EBITDA growth fails to reach ~25%
- if management does not cut costs and no bidder emerges

> *"kanskje risk-reward den beste bette"*

---

### 🟢 AUTO — AutoStore | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Listed among Eika's momentum overweights; recovered after falling to 5.

#### Reasoning

Eika holds an overweight because its estimates are above consensus, and the stock is starting to prove itself to foreign investors.

#### Sell Triggers

- if estimates are cut

> *"Kitron, Kongsberg-gruppen, Autostore. Det er jo liksom momentum-aksjene vi har"*

---

### 🟡 STB — Storebrand | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

A value case in Eika's Norway fund.

#### Reasoning

Mentioned briefly as a value holding, without further detail.

> *"så har vi jo litt sånn value case i Storbrann og Jensidie og Venn"*

---

### 🟡 GJF — Gjensidige | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

A value case in Eika's Norway fund; growing well.

#### Reasoning

Held as a value position; named as growing well compared with the salmon farmers.

> *"så har vi jo litt sånn value case i Storbrann og Jensidie og Venn"*

---

### ⛔ SALM — SalMar | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

At 17x next year's earnings versus a fair maximum of 12x, with limited volume growth, rising costs and heavy debt. Eika expects the sector to be re-priced if prices stay below 80.

#### Reasoning

Salmon is a pure commodity with 1-3% volume growth, zero sector return over five years and a ~2.5% free cash flow yield. The guest needs at least an 8-9% free cash flow yield to own it. Costs are rising toward 70 per kg against a price of about 75. Eika only holds salmon seasonally, until February.

#### Sell Triggers

- if salmon prices sustainably rise for 2-3 years
- if capex is cut sharply and FCF yield reaches 8-9%

> *"spesielt da Salmar som er liksom, det skal rett ned i P12"*

---

### ⛔ MOWI — Mowi | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

The guest is structurally bearish on salmon farmers, though Eika bought some for the seasonal autumn-to-February trade. The host owns Mowi.

#### Reasoning

The sector's structural problems also apply to Mowi: low volume growth, commodity pricing, rising costs, debt and weak free cash flow. The only reason to own it is a short-term seasonal trade.

#### Sell Triggers

- seasonal exit by February

> *"det er jo klart dårligste sektoren i Norden"*

---

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Eika's estimates are above consensus. Nvidia is still growing ~100% and trades at about 15x P/E on forward estimates; the guest sees no AI bubble.

#### Reasoning

The guest prefers AI infrastructure suppliers over the companies spending on AI. Nvidia receives most of the AI capex and is widening its moat.

#### Sell Triggers

- if hyperscaler capex slows
- if Middle East unresolved pushes rates higher

> *"Det har vært riktig, og det gjelder faktisk også Nvidia."*

---

### ⛔ NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Given as an example of quality investors losing money as earnings halved.

#### Reasoning

Mentioned as a cautionary example, not as an explicit position.

> *"De som var quality-investorer og kjøpte Novo, Novo sine apps halverte seg, aksjene halverte seg."*
